notes.title: Blockee - Steam Puzzle Fest
notes.notes:
🚨 Attention, puzzle lovers! 🧩 

Blockee is now 30% off during the Steam Puzzle Fest, from April 24th to May 1st. 
This minimalist puzzle game, inspired by the classic Klostki, will challenge your brain and keep you entertained for hours. 

Don't miss out on this limited-time offer and grab your copy now to enjoy solo or challenge a friend!



Plus, check out our others great puzzle games at discounted prices:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2231550/The_Travelers_Path/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1745710/Cato_the_cat/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1513310/Blockee__Sliding_Puzzle
